snippet.title: Battle of Antietam © 1986 SSI - PC DOS - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The battlelines are drawn. Now you assume command of BATTLE OF ANTIETAM, a grand-tactical simulation of the bloodiest day of the Civil War. From the first shots at 6 AM until darkness ends the carnage at 5 PM, the action unfolds in detail so realistic you will fell like you are playing a miniatures game.
